operator_direction: Use existing measurements; operator reports finger flex and caliper variation. No further manual measurements requested.

measurement.note: Actual released gap remeasured without intentionally repositioning the jaws, to 0.1 mm. Previous nominal 45 mm report is preserved separately. Provisional +/-0.25 mm manual-placement allowance, not a verified instrument specification.

limitations: Interpolation only; range endpoints are not mechanical stops
No motor zero, CAD slider zero, jaw force or loaded-motion validation
Invalid after encoder zero changes or transmission maintenance

fit.purpose: Approximate unloaded total aperture estimate; no precise contact or force control
fit.selection: Use the 45.5 mm actual remeasurement in place of the nominal 45 mm report at essentially unchanged encoder position; all original evidence retained.
fit.uncertainty_basis: User confirmed finger flex and caliper variation and requested use of existing measurements. +/-1 mm sample allowance and 2 mm fit criterion are provisional engineering choices, not independently verified bounds.

assessment: Approximate unloaded aperture conversion only. Original 1 mm fit remains rejected; separate coarse assessment uses a provisional 2 mm error criterion and +/-1 mm measurement allowance. This is not an independently validated uncertainty bound.
